notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/87f5a29fb32e8c2b0792e3d7e41c006799425451.png

Hello soldiers!

Considering that the update came out later than planned, the holiday in the game was extended until November 30. In addition to extending the event, a new mode was added, new easter eggs (old pumpkin easter eggs are NOT EXTENDED!). In the near future, it is planned to add abilities to all Halloween skins.

Innovations:
- Added MUTAGEN fan mode. You can only kill an enemy in this mode by turning him into a little animal! This can be done with a special potion grenade (MUTAGEN), which can be thrown on the G button;
- Added new Easter eggs - animals. Once every 30 minutes, one of the players randomly turns into an Easter egg, and the rest players begin to hunt for him! The task of the animal is to survive 5 minutes to receive a reward of 250 coins. If you fail to survive, then the reward will be divided between hunters in proportion to the damage done. The hunt lasts 5 minutes. Easter eggs spawn on the modes: Battle, Contra, Melee, Zombie, Survival, Domination. The requirement for the spawn of the Easter Egg is at least 10 players on the server.

Changes:

 Fixes made in zombie mode. The mode no longer lags;
 Added hand animations for zombies;
 Minor customer optimization.


If problems arise, the game servers may be restarted!

Goog game for all!

notes.title: Update 30.10.2019
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/87f5a29fb32e8c2b0792e3d7e41c006799425451.png

Hello soldiers!

And here is the second part of the holiday update (and not the last)!

On October 31, Easter eggs (pumpkins) and ghosts will spawn in the game. This year changes were made for Easter eggs and ghosts. The hunting season is open!

The ghosts are now weaker and can be killed not only with a explosives, but also with "Cursed Bones" edition weapons. They spawn on the servers once an hour. For killing ghosts, players gain experience (100 experience per ghost). For killing the Ghost Boss, the players are given a lot of experience (who has killed earns 500 experience, and another 500 experience is divided into all others players in proportion to the damage done)! For spawn ghosts on the server must be at least 10 people.

Easter eggs will now spawn more often and according to the new system every 10 minutes with a certain chance (15% chance for small and 5% for large). For spawns of small Easter eggs on the server there must be at least 10 people, and large ones - 12 people. From small Easter eggs you can get from 3 to 10 coins, and after the spawn they disappear after 15 seconds. Large Easter eggs do not disappear after the spawn, and the reward of 250 coins is divided between the players in proportion to the damage done. That player, who will kill Large Easter egg will receive an additional bonus: 20 M61, 20 SMELs, 20 MK3, 20 M202 and 50 pumpkins on the head! All types of Easter eggs can be found in the modes of Contra, Battle, Survival, Zombies, Domination. It is useless to search for Easter eggs on private servers!

Innovations:

 Added easter eggs for which you can get coins and ammunition;
 Added ghosts for killing which you can gain experience;
 Added maps for the modes: Melee (2 BRIDGES), Contra (FAUBOURG, TURBINE, DOUBLECROSS, AZTECS).


Changes:

 Made balanced edits for weapons PSG1, Benelli M3, Benelli M3 Cursed Bones, Bekas12, Neostead 2000, Benelli M2, Benelli M4, Vepr12;
 Replaced sounds for some weapons from the latest updates.


Corrections:

 Changes have been made to improve game performance;
 Made corrections to the server part of the game.


Festive decoration, skins, weapons "Cursed Bones" and coins offers will be in the game until November 17-18, 2019.

Easter eggs and ghosts will be in the game until November 3 23/59/59!

Good luck in your search👻

notes.title: Update 15.10.2019
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/168dce5318d674152f2804604d87f65f3ae1620b.png

Hello soldiers!

Today, another update was successfully installed on the game servers, which brought a new mode to the game.

Innovations:

 The "GunGame" mode has been added to the game. In this mode, players are divided into 2 teams, but there can only be one winner on the map. The peculiarity of the mode is that the player is given a certain weapon with which he will play, starting with Glock and ending with the Shovel. During the game, the player’s weapon will change depending on his actions on the map (to change weapons, you need to do 2 or 5 kills on the map depending on the weapon). In total, 20 levels of weapons await you, including the Shovel itself. On the map, the one who first kills the player from the opposing team with Shovel at level 20 wins. When killing with a shovel at any other level, your level will increase, and the level of the enemy will decrease.


Changes:

 Removed the "Alpha" and "1945" modes, which will return to the game for the corresponding holidays.


Corrections:

 Fixed a bug with a mine in the "Domination" mode;
 The server part was edited in order to improve performance and reduce the number and time of freezes;
 Other minor fixes.


At the moment, we are preparing a HALLOWEEN update, which can be expected at the end of the month. We do not have an exact update date, but something new awaits you😉

Thank you all for your activity. Good game!

notes.title: Update 05.09.2019
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34709963/d657857ae478a53a9ddf8d8cbc17143d7a830954.png

Hello soldiers!

Summer ended and autumn came. Someone started studying, someone returned from vacation, and the next update came out in the Blockade Classic.
In this update, we have moved a bit away from plans to implement a system of reports about suspicious activity by players. This decision was made due to the fact that after the previous update, the possibility of using and developing cheats was minimized and the cheaters in the game were temporarily lost.
This respite allowed us to focus on other tasks of the project. Many of you have long asked for the opportunity to earn more coins than the daily and weekly bonus gives. But no sweet without some sweat. Therefore, we decided to take the next step in the development of the game - the launch of daily and weekly tournaments among players.
These tournaments are automatic and are held without the participation of judges.
To become a participant in the tournament you need to buy a pass to the tournament, part of the cost of which goes to the formation of the prize pool.
Аdministration provides a starting prize fund for each tournament.
The more participants in the tournament - the greater the prize pool and the more prizes.
The minimum number of tournament participants is 10.
The minimum number of prizes is 5.
At the end of the tournament, provided there are not enough participants (less than 10 participants), the tournament is considered unsuccessful and a refund is made for the tournament.
Tournament winners are determined by the maximum amount of experience gained during the tournament.
Remember that with the PREMIUM, the earned experience doubles, as well as the chances of winning the tournament!
If you enter the tournament - the number of coins that you can earn will depend on you! The more you play, the more chances you will increase your capital!

DAILY TOURNAMENT


 The tournament starts every day automatically at 00 hours 00 minutes GMT.
 The duration of the tournament is 24 hours.
 The starting prize pool of the tournament is 300 coins.
 The cost of a tournament pass is 2 coins, of which 1 coin is credited to the tournament prize pool.
 The number of prizes is 15% of the total number of participants.
 Reward for first place is 25% of the prize pool but not more than 300 coins.
 The remainder of the prize fund is distributed among the winners in proportion to the prize place.
 Tournament information is updated 1 time per minute.


WEEKLY TOURNAMENT


 The tournament starts every Thursday automatically at 00 hours 00 minutes GMT.
 The duration of the tournament is 7 days.
 The starting prize pool of the tournament is 1500 coins.
 The cost of a tournament pass is 10 coins, of which 7 coins are credited to the tournament prize pool.
 The number of prizes is 15% of the total number of participants.
 Reward for first place is 25% of the prize pool but not more than 1500 coins.
 The remainder of the prize fund is distributed among the winners in proportion to the prize place.
 Tournament information is updated 1 time per minute.


Valid restrictions:

 To enroll experience in tournament statistics, you must play on servers with at least 16 players present.
 if a player violates the rules of the game (see the RULES section in the main menu of the game), his achievements in the tournament can be canceled, and the funds spent on the purchase of a pass to the tournament will not be refundable.


*By purchasing a pass to the tournament, you agree to the above conditions of the tournament and acknowledge that if you fail to win a prize, you will lose coins spent on the purchase of a pass.

*beta - tournaments are launched in beta testing mode. Tournament terms, restrictions, and tournament rewards may change over time.

In addition to tournaments, there are other changes in this update:


 Added a description of all items in the main menu of the game and when choosing weapons in the game.
 Added the correct names of items in the main menu of the game and when choosing weapons in the game.
 Added an indicator of the amount of purchased ammunition for 1 purchase.
 Changed game bonus notification system.
 Added display of received rewards in daily bonus.
 Optimized updating the list of servers in the main menu of the game.
 Optimized the system of buying items in the game.
 Fixed access to Scorpion weapon in the presence of a megapack.
 Fixed display of the number of ammunition when choosing weapons in the game.


We hope this update brings a new meaning to the game for some of you. And we will continue to work on the development of the project and bring something new to it.

Good game to all!

Hello soldiers!

Vacations are over and we are renewing our efforts to proceed to the next stage in the development of the project. And our next step will be to strengthen the protection of the game from the use of cheats. There are not many innovations in this update, but they are designed to complicate the use of cheats by dishonest players, and cheat developers to create new versions of cheats. 

List of changes: 

 Upgrade to the new version of Unity 2019.2.0 
 Changed the way the game is compiled in order to complicate hacking the game code. 
 Fixed a bug with an endless score in 1945 mode. 


If you have problems logging into the server, you must force the game to upgrade to a new version. If you have problems after the update, feel free to write about it in the relevant community topics. 

Good game everyone!

notes.title: Update 12.04.19
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709963/168dce5318d674152f2804604d87f65f3ae1620b.png

Hello, fighters!

First of all, we want to congratulate you on the International Day of Human Space Flight! May all your undertakings reach the same heights as Yuri Gagarin once reached!

In honor of this momentous day in the game starts the action on the purchase of in-game currency, which will last until the end of next week. The description and conditions of the action can be found in the main menu in the coin replenishment section.

Innovations:

 The discount system when buying coins is added to the game. It is calculated depending on the amount of previously purchased coins and works for purchases of 100 coins or more (including action offers). The discount increases with every purchase.
 The ability to view your transaction history has been added to the coin replenishment section. Now, if coins didn’t come to you when buying them, you need to open the HISTORY tab in the coins replenishment section, find the pending transaction (marked in red) and click the UPDATE button. If the transaction was previously confirmed by you - the coins will be issued to you automatically.
 Changed the player's nickname change algorithm - now when you try to use non-printable characters in the nickname, they will be ignored. If the nickname consists entirely of non-printable characters, it will automatically be replaced by the Player+SteamID64. Also, this algorithm automatically processes the player's nickname when entering the game and when connecting to the game server. If you notice that your nickname has changed when entering the game or on the server, please use the printable characters the next time you change your nickname.


We are continuing to fix bugs and errors in the game and want to thank everyone for their active participation in this!

Thank you for your attention and good game!

notes.title: Update 06.04.19
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34709963/168dce5318d674152f2804604d87f65f3ae1620b.png

Hi, Fighters!

We are glad to announce the first large-scale update in the game! This update brings to the game several significant innovations and the correction of many errors.

Innovations:

 Servers are divided into 2 types - for players up to level 5 inclusive and for all others. Now you can see the list of servers according to your level. This is done by the numerous requests of the community and will allow new players to "painlessly" join the game, deal with game mechanics, acquire the initial "skill" and generally understand and feel the game.
Attention! Weapons that do not match the server level will not be available in inventory!
 Added the ability to play with friends. Now in the main menu in the "GAME" section added the tab "WITH A FRIEND". It contains a list of servers on which your friends are currently playing. At the moment you can simply connect to the server your friend is playing on. In the future, we will improve this mechanics for more detailed interaction with friends.


Corrections:

 Fixed a weapon that fell out of the hands when dying - now the falling out weapon corresponds to what was in the hands.
 Fixed changing the player's skin when changing map on the server.
 Fixed localization of the drawing range options in the OPTIONS menu.
 Fixed automatic reloading of the Crossbow after the shot.

As well as many minor fixes and improvements.

ATTENTION! If you do not observe the changes described above, or have problems with access to servers or displaying menu items - you need to check the relevance of your version of the game client. If necessary, it should be updated manually through the "Check the integrity of the game files."

Good luck on the battlefield!
